metadata.name: Juggernaut (Hakan's galaxy evolution mix) [2k17 edition]
metadata.author: martin
metadata.source: martin - Juggernaut (Hakan's galaxy evolution mix) [2k17 edition].milk

perFrameCode: qdev = 0; i =0; loop (num_res,  qdev += pow(megabuf(i+3)-qavg,2); i += 8;);
t= 0 ; q1 = sin(t); q2 = cos(t); q3 = -q2; q4 = q1;
v1 = bass*k1; v2 = mid*k1; v3 = treb*k1;
c1 = cos(v1); c2 = cos(v2); c3 = cos(v3);
s1 = sin(v1); s2 = sin(v2); s3 = sin(v3);

perPointCode: my_x = sqrt(r1 * r1 - q10 * q10) * cos(q11);
my_y = sqrt(r1 * r1 - q10 * q10) * sin(q11);
